title: Georgia Power renewable growth to continue throughout 2018
lineage: Original offtaker announcement on its parent company’s site.

passages.locator: REDI awards, paragraph on the Invenergy subsidiary
passages.note: Georgia Power identifies Invenergy subsidiary Camilla Solar Energy LLC as its REDI power-purchase counterparty for a 160 MW project in Camilla. The successful projects came from the 2017 REDI request for proposals.
